seams_opened.title: assemble_agent roster edit has no write-time owner↔emit / non-empty revalidation (remove can orphan a gradeable flag's owner or empty the roster)
seams_opened.fix_location: apps/bff/app.py _assemble_agent (+ a future author-time or grade-time owner-revalidation surface)
seams_opened.impact: Removing a judge whose lens owns a gradeable flag leaves that flag unowned; per CLAUDE.md invariant #4 the council would exclude it at grade time (a NARROWER council, not a wrong verdict) — and the roster can be emptied. By-design for edit-one-facet (the add path IS guarded by LENS_BY_ROLE, never fabricates a judge); surfaced so the monitor/spec-author can decide whether a roster edit should warn on orphaning, analogous to S-BS-83's owner-authoring boundary.
seams_opened.evidence: apps/bff/app.py _assemble_agent: the add path checks `add_judge not in LENS_BY_ROLE` (404), but the remove path is an unconditional `judges.remove(remove_judge)` with no owner↔emit re-check and no non-empty guard; put_agent_endpoint's agent_from_dict round-trip accepts an empty judges tuple (structurally valid).
